title: Protect initial attack window
text: Prioritize rapid containment while the perimeter is still small. Confirm access, water supply and escape routes before committing crews.

title: Use wind as primary spread cue
text: Check flank exposure and expected head-fire direction. If wind increases, reinforce anchor points and avoid unsupported direct attack.

title: Keep information loop active
text: Update occurrence status, observed behaviour and resource deployment so future modules can learn from operational decisions.
